description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Kalutara District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, specifically the postponement of local authority elections in the Kalutara Administrative District. It contains a notice of poll under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, announces the change of election date from March 9, 2023 to April 25, 2023, and lists the affected local authorities. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover election announcements, schedules, and related electoral commission decisions.
